  • IPA(key): (Balearic) [i.ðə.o.luˈʒi.ə]
  • IPA(key): (Valencia) [i.ðe.o.loˈd͡ʒi.a]
  • Audio (Barcelona):(file)

Noun

[edit]

ideologia f (plural ideologies)

  1. ideology

Related terms

[edit]
  • ideòleg
  • ideològic

ideologia

Interlingua

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From Italian ideologia, Spanish ideología, Portuguese ideologia, English ideology, German Ideologie and Russian идеоло́гия (ideológija), all from French idéologie.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /i.de.oˈlo.ʒa/, /-d͡ʒa/, /-ɡi.a/

Noun

[edit]

ideologia (plural ideologias)

  1. ideology

Further reading

[edit]
  • Alexander Gode (1951), Interlingua-English: A Dictionary of the International Language, New York: Storm Publishers, →OL

Polish

[edit]
Polish Wikipedia has an article on:
ideologia
Wikipedia pl

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from French idéologie. By surface analysis, idea +‎ -o- +‎ -logia.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /i.dɛ.ɔˈlɔ.ɡja/
  • Audio:(file)
  • Rhymes: -ɔɡja
  • Syllabification: i‧de‧o‧lo‧gia

Noun

[edit]

ideologia f

  1. ideology

Declension

[edit]
Declension of ideologia
singular plural
nominative ideologia ideologie
genitive ideologii ideologii/ideologij (archaic)
dative ideologii ideologiom
accusative ideologię ideologie
instrumental ideologią ideologiami
locative ideologii ideologiach
vocative ideologio ideologie

Related terms

[edit]
adjective
  • ideologiczny
adverb
  • ideologicznie
noun
  • ideolog

Further reading

[edit]
  • “ideologia”, in Wielki słownik języka polskiego‎[2] (in Polish), Instytut Języka Polskiego PAN
  • “ideologia”, in Polish dictionaries at PWN‎[3] (in Polish)
